integration: Expose pub mod blast_result_pipeline and worker-owned blast_prelim_evaluate in core/mod.rs. Expose pub mod nucleotide_search and optionally export search_nucleotide_database/NucleotideSearchResults/NucleotideSearchError in lib.rs.

Native search_nucleotide_database(batch:&PreparedNucleotideBatch,database:&NucleotideDatabase)->Result<NucleotideSearchResults,NucleotideSearchError> builds original setup, obtains raw preliminary HSPs, runs worker source evaluation/purge/sort/Evalue/prelim-reap, inserts through original preliminary collector and feeds enabled low_score thresholds back exactly at original engine boundary. Only retained collector candidates undergo traceback using parent split traceback_preliminary_subject; no preliminary rescan.

Candidate stream transfer assigns per-query list.query_index and sorts decreasing OID/read-from-end as original HSPStreamClose/BatchRead. Final retained candidates use original HSPResultsInsertHSPList, ResultsSortByEvalue and mapped prune. Native loop holds typed owners instead of stream/SeqSrc callbacks.

Returned HSPResults is in memory with query_ids, subject_ids, settled effective-length query_info, task, ungapped statistics and preliminary/traced candidate counts. HSP context and coordinates remain native per-context values; OIDs index subject_ids. Formatting/oriented endpoint/reporting adapters are separate work.

Default-only search options mean optional final max-HSP/query-coverage/best-hit/culling/mask-level filters are inactive upstream and do not add extra processing here. Both standard blastn and megablast task choices are inherited from PreparedNucleotideBatch.

Temporary assembly limitation: native per-subject preliminary setup lacks original >MAX_DBSEQ_LEN chunk split/merge, so native API returns a structured error for subjects over5M until chunking is implemented. This is outstanding goal work, not a final supported-scope restriction. Other database/query dimensions respect original integer bounds.
superseded_limit_note: The earlier temporary5M nucleotide limit has been removed: subject-chunk and protein-chunks integrations now bind original5M/100 geometry in nucleotide or translated-AA coordinates respectively. See those integration records.
